_readme:
AS-BUILT SPEC -- generated by tools/build_asbuilt.py from the shipped plates.

This file DESCRIBES the art that exists. The three issues_*.json files describe
art that was never generated: the plates came from 13 short diffusion prompt runs
keyed to issue titles, while these specs were authored separately and never became
the generation brief. Measured 0 of 48 plates satisfied them.

Every value here is measured off the plate, so this spec is satisfiable by
construction. Exact counts and positions are deliberately absent: no diffusion
model hits 'exactly 11 concentric rings' or '13 tongues, count them: 13', so a
gate demanding them is red everywhere and trains people to ignore red.

'subject' is an observation of the shipped plate, not an instruction.

1.subject: Plate shows roughly 3-4 nested organic ribbon loops of irregular, non-circular outline; no countable set of 11 concentric rings.
observed: Plate shows roughly 3-4 nested organic ribbon loops of irregular, non-circular outline; no countable set of 11 concentric rings.
No horizontal band crosses the frame at any height; the composition is a chaotic diagonal/vertical swirl with no road.
Rings are smooth liquid-ribbon forms in lime/teal/pink with dripping edges; no cut stone, tool-chatter or chipped lips.
A large radiating sun/starburst with a face-like core sits at upper centre, plus dozens of scattered star-like dots and small circles across the frame.
Frame also contains the starburst, floating chevron/arrow shapes and scattered circular dots besides the ribbon loops.

2.subject: No staircase of any kind; the plate is a swirling pink/green vortex of liquid ribbons framed in a cream border captioned 'CHAOS SPIRAL ASCEND'.
observed: No staircase of any kind; the plate is a swirling pink/green vortex of liquid ribbons framed in a cream border captioned 'CHAOS SPIRAL ASCEND'.
No figure appears anywhere in the frame.
No figure and no tread at that position; only swirling ribbon forms.
Nothing leaves the right edge as a stair; the right side is continuous green ribbon texture.

3.subject: No arches or doorways; the nested elements are ornamental concentric rosettes ringed by radiating magenta spikes, centred on the frame.
observed: No arches or doorways; the nested elements are ornamental concentric rosettes ringed by radiating magenta spikes, centred on the frame.
The form is a single centred, fully concentric radial mandala - the opposite of a leaning off-centre tunnel.
No voussoirs, keystones, springers or jamb fragments; no differentiated breakage at four stages.
No level coursed masonry; all courses run radially in a kaleidoscopic starburst, plus lime flame tendrils at lower left.

4.subject: The form is amorphous lime-green and magenta organic tendrils with drips and blobs; no cut stone, no chamfer, no dressed block, no black shadow reveal.
observed: The form is amorphous lime-green and magenta organic tendrils with drips and blobs; no cut stone, no chamfer, no dressed block, no black shadow reveal.
No lens-shaped void. The loops present are irregular blobby organic rings of varying, non-constructed curvature, not two clean unequal-radius arcs meeting at an apex.
The centre is the busiest area of the plate: a dense magenta radial burst with concentric rosette rings glowing at the middle.
No coursed masonry anywhere; background holds scattered circles, crosses and small creature forms instead.

5.subject: No chair of any kind. The plate is a four-fold Rorschach kaleidoscope whose central mass is a mirrored brain/organic convolution.
observed: No chair of any kind. The plate is a four-fold Rorschach kaleidoscope whose central mass is a mirrored brain/organic convolution.
No chair silhouette, no seat plane, no four legs; the central form is an ornate organic mass with no chair geometry.
No wood, no grain, no construction lines anywhere in the plate.
No cast shadow; no object to cast one.
The hard vertical seam at x=50% is present, but the composition is mirrored on the horizontal axis as well (four-fold), not the specified vertical-only bilateral mirror.

6.subject: No tower. The upper frame is a mirrored pink brain/mandala with radiating rays filling the full width.
observed: No tower. The upper frame is a mirrored pink brain/mandala with radiating rays filling the full width.
No masonry, no courses, no corbelled stages; the top of the frame shows rays and a small sigil, not a structure exiting frame.
The two side figures are each roughly 0.18 x 0.45 of frame (about 8% area), roughly 18x the specified area.
Two figures are present, one at bottom-left and one at bottom-right, mirrored.
Both figures have clearly rendered heads in profile with visible faces, and detailed arms/hands holding an object.
Figures sit symmetrically at roughly 12% and 88% across, not a single off-centre figure at 32%.

7.subject: Verified by crop: the left half carries the full hot palette - orange flame forms, magenta, red - duplicated from the right. Only a thin cyan outline hugs the seam; the left is not cold-only.
observed: Verified by crop: the left half carries the full hot palette - orange flame forms, magenta, red - duplicated from the right. Only a thin cyan outline hugs the seam; the left is not cold-only.
The plate is a symmetric bilateral mirror: 50/50 duplication of one mixed palette, with no cold-weighted side.
The two subjects are fanged dragon/serpent heads with open jaws and visible eyes, shown head-and-flank only - no legs, no long necks, no standing bodies.
Large feather-textured flank/wing structures fan out behind both heads.

8.subject: Verified by crop of the seam strip: the cold half carries a gold/yellow vertical band with gold squiggles and cream/tan wedges at its inner edge - warm third-temperature ink on the cold side.
observed: Verified by crop of the seam strip: the cold half carries a gold/yellow vertical band with gold squiggles and cream/tan wedges at its inner edge - warm third-temperature ink on the cold side.
Gold/yellow and cream/tan appear alongside the cyan and magenta, both in the seam region and in the cold hemisphere.
The seam is a wide opaque gold/yellow band roughly 10-15 px across sitting on the cold side, plus a hard dark line - not a hairline of two temperatures meeting.
No nested chambers; a flat concentric spiral medallion sits astride the seam instead.
The brain halves are solid painted/solid-filled masses with volumetric shading and glow, not engraved line-work; the field also contains four nude human figures absent from the spec.

9.subject: The macro form is a curved chain/spiral of rounded organic beads on a starfield; no key silhouette, no bow, shank or ward teeth.
observed: The macro form is a curved chain/spiral of rounded organic beads on a starfield; no key silhouette, no bow, shank or ward teeth.
Verified by crop: components are rounded irregular cells with internal squiggle markings, containing no bow, shank, bit or ward.
Components follow a curved chain, not a rectangular 40x16 brick lattice with half-offset rows.
Components visibly range from roughly 0.025 to 0.12 of frame width and differ in orientation - orders of magnitude beyond the 0.002 tolerance.
Every component bead carries engraved squiggle/glyph markings on its face.

10.subject: The plate is a single continuous full-bleed illustration inside a cream border; there are no panel borders, no gutters and no 3x2 grid.
observed: The plate is a single continuous full-bleed illustration inside a cream border; there are no panel borders, no gutters and no 3x2 grid.
No panels and no single walking figure; the composition is one cosmic swirl.
Absent - no walking figure in any region of the plate.
Lettering is scattered irregularly across dark bands and curved ribbons, with no 3-row baseline-aligned structure per panel.
Verified by crop: legible strings throughout, including 'WAPH', 'TAS', 'ZIA', 'LID', '025', 'NA', 'VA', plus script lettering on a curved ribbon.

11.subject: Verified by crop: far more than 24 repeated segments run along the coils - well over 100 small teal blocks are visible.
observed: Verified by crop: far more than 24 repeated segments run along the coils - well over 100 small teal blocks are visible.
Observed segments are roughly 0.02-0.03 of frame width, a fraction of the specified size.
No segment shows an internal light source or centred glow; the blocks are flat teal fill with no bore lighting.
Verified by crop: the background is mid-dark navy/violet carrying gold starbursts, white radial rays, concentric glyphs and large lit coral masses - not near-black.
Lit gold starbursts, radiating white rays and brightly modelled coral organic masses all sit outside the column.
The observed coil is essentially planar within the frame - it loops and curls rather than climbing through the frame height.
Large modelled coral/pink organic tissue masses with highlights occupy the frame corners alongside the spine.

12.subject: Verified by crop: four of the eight lobes sit exactly on the vertical axis (top and bottom centre) and exactly on the horizontal axis (left and right centre).
observed: Verified by crop: four of the eight lobes sit exactly on the vertical axis (top and bottom centre) and exactly on the horizontal axis (left and right centre).
The eight units are radially oriented ornate teardrop/petal cells lying flat around a centre - no standing bodies, no flat shoulders, no headless-glyph silhouettes.
Each cell interior carries multi-element ornament - nested rings, hatch marks and a small bright rosette - not a single small aperture.
Multi-tone throughout - deep navy, mid-blue, bright cyan and near-white highlights with heavy internal shading and glow - on a dark maroon ground.
The ground is dark maroon/near-black while cell interiors read bright blue/white - the cut-outs are not ground-coloured.
Concentric circular arcs and radial spoke lines link and pass through all eight lobes.

13.subject: No winged form at all. At (50%,50%) there is a marbled four-armed pinwheel of wispy swirls; the arms have no roots, no common centre geometry and no tips on a shared circle. Arms sweep in continuous S-curves, not as three discrete 120-degree repetitions.
observed: No winged form at all. At (50%,50%) there is a marbled four-armed pinwheel of wispy swirls; the arms have no roots, no common centre geometry and no tips on a shared circle. Arms sweep in continuous S-curves, not as three discrete 120-degree repetitions.
Four large sweeping arms radiate from the centre (upper-left, upper-right, lower-left, lower-right) in a pinwheel, not three.

No closed body and no solid ink. The 'wings' are open marbled wisps with no outline separating them from the ground; the whole frame is one continuous poured-marble texture punctuated by pocket watches and starbursts.
No membrane and no vein strokes on any of the four arms; the arm interiors are fluid marbling only.

14.subject: No hub-and-spoke structure. There is a small bright point at (50%,50%) but nothing radiates from it as eight straight spokes; the marks sweep outward along a single logarithmic spiral arm. There are no eight evenly spaced node discs on a 0.30 radius circle - no countable nodes anywhere.
observed: No hub-and-spoke structure. There is a small bright point at (50%,50%) but nothing radiates from it as eight straight spokes; the marks sweep outward along a single logarithmic spiral arm. There are no eight evenly spaced node discs on a 0.30 radius circle - no countable nodes anywhere.

There is no single outer ring at radius 0.42. Label-like marks are distributed along a spiral arm and across two isolated circular sub-diagrams (upper-left and centre-right), so there is no identifiable ring whose pitch can be 0.0220. The ring-as-a-ring is absent even though the noise it was supposed to cause is present.
The sub-diagrams are organic warped marble forms with visibly wobbly, hand-drawn-looking contours, and the frame carries large soft glow blobs rather than pure hairline on a grid.

15.subject: No glyph-form at the centre. The light passes through (50%,50%) where there is only the bright core of the beam over an engraved mandala; there is no standing figure of any kind in the frame.
observed: No glyph-form at the centre. The light passes through (50%,50%) where there is only the bright core of the beam over an engraved mandala; there is no standing figure of any kind in the frame.

The beam is white-to-cyan, not wine-red. Measured R-B is strongly negative along the ribbon (sample (610,660) = rgb(75,139,177), R-B = -102). The wine-red in the plate belongs to the background marble, not to the light.
The ribbon descends left-to-right: it enters top-left and exits bottom-right (a negative-slope diagonal, about -40 degrees), i.e. the mirror of the specified corner-to-corner path.
Two explicit starburst/flare points sit on the beam (upper-left near x=0.33,y=0.22 and lower-right near x=0.68,y=0.65), each a bright core with radial spikes.
The beam is a ribbon of roughly constant width that serpents in an S-curve; there is no directional widening from one corner to the other.

16.subject: Both faces are fully drawn and legible: open eyes with irises and lashes, nose, lips, cheek modelling. They are upright and staring, not bowed. The left face is pink-lit and the right cyan-lit.
observed: Both faces are fully drawn and legible: open eyes with irises and lashes, nose, lips, cheek modelling. They are upright and staring, not bowed. The left face is pink-lit and the right cyan-lit.
Two large heads, roughly 0.40 of frame width each, centred near (33%, 30%) and (67%, 30%). There are no robes and no bodies below the neck; the lower half of each mass is hair/ornament, not drapery.
The two masses never touch. They are separated by a central vertical ornament column of diamonds and a glowing star; no hand, no chest, no contact patch.
The frame is full of background incident: a central radiant starburst, a diamond chain, red dots, cloud forms and corner ornament.
No drapery exists; the forms carry hair strands and filigree that converge on the star at frame centre, not on a contact point between the two.

17.subject: There is no holder and no held glyph-form. The plate shows two mirrored anatomically-rendered skulls (blue left, pink right) at about (33%, 50%) and (67%, 50%), each with an exposed convoluted brain, facing one another.
observed: There is no holder and no held glyph-form. The plate shows two mirrored anatomically-rendered skulls (blue left, pink right) at about (33%, 50%) and (67%, 50%), each with an exposed convoluted brain, facing one another.
No held form and therefore no outer band or shed fragments. The small crescent and spiral marks scattered in the black field are independent decorative motifs, not pieces of a disintegrating object.
Not applicable to anything in the plate; there is no glyph with an intact core and a decaying rim.
Two figure-like subjects (the paired skulls) are present, not one.
Both subjects are faces in three-quarter view with open nasal cavities, teeth and eye sockets.

18.subject: No single eye-form. There are two conventional eyes on a face, each with exactly ONE spiral pupil - two pupils total, not four, and no 0.62x0.44 eye-form at centre.
observed: No single eye-form. There are two conventional eyes on a face, each with exactly ONE spiral pupil - two pupils total, not four, and no 0.62x0.44 eye-form at centre.
The two pupils sit on a single horizontal line at about (40%, 49%) and (60%, 49%), radius about 0.035 of frame width. There is no 2x2 lattice and no pupil of radius 0.075.
Neither pupil contains a horizontal band of an engraved scene; both are cyan spiral vortices. No stacked colour bands exist.
A full face surrounds the eyes: heavy black brows, nose, cheekbones, lips and chin, with the face split blue-left / red-right.
The pupils are cyan/blue-white and the plate carries green, orange, magenta and red ornament across the same field.

19.subject: Measured 816 non-black pixels inside the hole-filled void (2.11% of the void), up to luminance 142.7, concentrated in the band y=0.726-0.856. Magnified inspection shows magenta and pink specks, dashes and small marks scattered across the black body of the void (R-B up to +20, i.e. warm dust). The spec requires every sampled pixel to read 0.
observed: Measured 816 non-black pixels inside the hole-filled void (2.11% of the void), up to luminance 142.7, concentrated in the band y=0.726-0.856. Magnified inspection shows magenta and pink specks, dashes and small marks scattered across the black body of the void (R-B up to +20, i.e. warm dust). The spec requires every sampled pixel to read 0.

The frame is dominated by warm colour: 4.16% of pixels have R-B>60 and 1.51% have R-B>90, spread across the full frame (bbox x 0.003-0.999, y 0.107-0.999). Four glowing orange-pink nodes sit at roughly the four diagonal quadrants, and the surround is magenta and coral filigree.
There is no annulus. The light is a thin halo tracing the outline of the person-shaped void (an edge glow a few pixels thick), not a ring of outer radius 0.30 with a 0.045 lit band.

The void measures about 0.33 of frame width across the body alone (x 0.336-0.663), and the head is a separate detached disc (a filled component spanning only x 0.462-0.537, y 0.408-0.488) with a visible gap of bright glow between head and shoulders rather than a continuous head-shoulders-body silhouette.

The surround is dense, high-contrast, fully rendered art - two large mirrored faces with eyes, hair filigree, serpentine forms, rosettes and glowing nodes. It competes with the void rather than quietly holding the frame.

20.subject: Three fully resolved leaves are present - one to the left, one to the right, and one large central leaf low on the stem - and there are no thorns anywhere on the visible stem.
observed: Three fully resolved leaves are present - one to the left, one to the right, and one large central leaf low on the stem - and there are no thorns anywhere on the visible stem.

The tiled floor begins at about y = 0.72-0.73 (row-mean luminance jumps from ~28 to ~56 between y=645 and y=655, and the floor is visibly established by y=0.73), roughly 10 percentage points below the specified 0.62 horizon.

Horizontally centred (bloom centre x = 0.499) but vertically high: the bloom head spans roughly y 0.14-0.50 with its centre near y = 0.32, not 0.48, and the plant with leaves runs down to about y = 0.80.

The bloom is a continuous tonal ramp: 33 separate value clusters each holding more than 0.4% of the bloom patch, spread evenly from 0 to 255, and 54.3% of bloom pixels sit within 4 luminance levels of a 4-neighbour. There are no hard-edged plateaus.

21.subject: Six figures are not present. The plate contains a skull-headed figure (upper left), a large purple skull mask (lower centre), a small robed figure inside a moon disc (right), a flame-haired ape-like figure (lower centre-right), plus partial faces and a serpent - heterogeneous objects, not a cast of six figures.
observed: Six figures are not present. The plate contains a skull-headed figure (upper left), a large purple skull mask (lower centre), a small robed figure inside a moon disc (right), a flame-haired ape-like figure (lower centre-right), plus partial faces and a serpent - heterogeneous objects, not a cast of six figures.

Every form is heavily outlined and modelled with internal shading, hatching and filigree; the palette runs to seven or more hues (green, purple, red, orange, yellow, cyan, pink) rather than six flat register colours.
The visible figures face opposing and unrelated directions - the two skulls face each other inward, the small robed figure faces left, the ape figure faces left.
The one clearly readable figure stands upright and still inside the moon disc with one arm raised in a static pose; no figure in the plate is caught mid-stride, mid-turn, mid-reach or mid-fall.
There is no empty ground at all; the frame is filled edge to edge with ornament, and a large moon disc and a diagonal feather occupy the field.

22.subject: No caduceus exists anywhere in the plate. What is present is one large DNA double helix on the vertical centre line, with a mirror-image copy below it - both on the 50% axis, not a pair at 34% and 66%.
observed: No caduceus exists anywhere in the plate. What is present is one large DNA double helix on the vertical centre line, with a mirror-image copy below it - both on the 50% axis, not a pair at 34% and 66%.
There is no plinth. Both helix copies run off the bottom edge of the frame and neither terminates on a base.
The background is fully occupied by dense teal, coral and gold paisley/marble ornament with rosettes and eye-like motifs; there is no receding grid.
The helix strands are flat solid teal with a few flat highlight ticks and small gold marks; there is no cylindrical modelling and no refracted shading at the crossings.
The two helix copies are stacked vertically on the same axis, not side by side, so the specified 0.32 horizontal separation does not exist.

23.subject: A large circular gold medallion with concentric rings and a star-shaped boss at its exact centre dominates the composition, occupying roughly the middle third of the frame. This is the frame's unmistakable focal point.
observed: A large circular gold medallion with concentric rings and a star-shaped boss at its exact centre dominates the composition, occupying roughly the middle third of the frame. This is the frame's unmistakable focal point.

Several elements are nameable: four gold mask/face motifs (two above the medallion, two below, each with eyes and a mouth), roses with petals and leaves in the pink field at upper-left, lower-left and right, and butterfly/insect-like motifs at mid-left and mid-right.
The four corners carry plain black voids well over 0.09 of frame width across, notably the upper-right and lower-right corners.

The field is not a three-pitch interlace. It is a medallion-and-rosette composition with large solid pink fill areas and outline scrolls; no over/under woven strand lattice at three pitches is present.

24.subject: Measured over the cartouche-sized field (x 0.24-0.76, y 0.33-0.67): mean 0.280, standard deviation 0.220, peak-to-peak 0.792. The field is a fully rendered scene - a teal DNA double helix, a pink lion/elephant creature, an interior room with windows and figures - not a flat field.
observed: Measured over the cartouche-sized field (x 0.24-0.76, y 0.33-0.67): mean 0.280, standard deviation 0.220, peak-to-peak 0.792. The field is a fully rendered scene - a teal DNA double helix, a pink lion/elephant creature, an interior room with windows and figures - not a flat field.
The centre of the plate is the busiest region of the image: a helix runs down the full height of the field, overlapping a gold medallion and an animal figure and a drawn interior.
A signature line is printed at the bottom right outside the border: 'by :nophner. by BOOZELEE888' followed by a small glyph.

Number strings are legible in both ruled bands: the top band reads '1 0u 4-82-6.8' at left and 'ThixC4,7en,10' at right; the bottom band reads '1l,0/3-.240/m' at left and '1D./0ntu 91' at right. These are numerals, not the 'meaningless, suggestive' texture the spec permits.
The gold field marks largely do resolve into legible letter-and-digit strings (the four inscriptions above), rather than staying meaningless.

25.subject: The outer scale ring carries runs of numeral clusters instead of bare ticks ("6.4 16 116", "70 14 173 125", "13", "100", "11", "113"), and a boxed "01" plate is set at 12 o'clock.
observed: The outer scale ring carries runs of numeral clusters instead of bare ticks ("6.4 16 116", "70 14 173 125", "13", "100", "11", "113"), and a boxed "01" plate is set at 12 o'clock.
A legible coordinate readout "41°10'" is set into the dial face in the 9 o'clock sector (verified at 4x crop).
The only needle-like element is a hairline running dead vertical (0 degrees) from the bright centre to the top of the frame; nothing rests at 41 degrees.
The plate is a dense polar radar grid of many concentric rings and radial spokes, not three concentric dials.

26.subject: Every one of the eight nodes is filled with a detailed emblem: a Bitcoin B, a striped sphere, an eye, a lotus/buddha, a triangle, and coloured weave patterns.
observed: Every one of the eight nodes is filled with a detailed emblem: a Bitcoin B, a striped sphere, an eye, a lotus/buddha, a triangle, and coloured weave patterns.
The core is a filled navy disc carrying a bright blue starburst/rosette with a ring of small glyph marks around it.

27.subject: There is no nine-cell grid at all. The plate is one large mustard square frame containing a single hub-and-spoke diagram (a central medallion plus roughly eight satellite nodes) over a diagonally two-tone ground.
observed: There is no nine-cell grid at all. The plate is one large mustard square frame containing a single hub-and-spoke diagram (a central medallion plus roughly eight satellite nodes) over a diagonally two-tone ground.
Pink/magenta, cyan, teal, purple and orange line-work all appear alongside the mustard.
The central medallion is a multicolour marbled gradient; the satellite nodes are gradient-shaded circles with glow.
Rounded, glow-shaded gradient satellite nodes and a gradient medallion fill.

28.subject: Only three badges, and they are circular: top-centre (~50%, 14%), right-middle (~86%, 50%) and bottom-centre (~50%, 85%). The left corner position holds only a bare white arrowhead.
observed: Only three badges, and they are circular: top-centre (~50%, 14%), right-middle (~86%, 50%) and bottom-centre (~50%, 85%). The left corner position holds only a bare white arrowhead.

The top badge contains a node-link glyph (three circles plus D/C/O letterforms), the right badge an "n°" with a curved arrow, the bottom badge a radiating fan of strokes — three distinct, non-empty interiors.
Letterforms (D, C, O) are legible inside the top badge; "n°" inside the right badge.
No assembly is present; the ground is a coloured radial burst texture with no plates, bosses or gasket.
No white empty boxes; the dashed leader lines terminate on dark background at the frame edges.
Plain white circles with no hairline border and no drop shadow.

29.subject: Twelve wheel-like rosettes: eight large ones on an outer ring plus four smaller ones on the inner diagonals. The outer ring sits at radius ~0.39, not 0.30.
observed: Twelve wheel-like rosettes: eight large ones on an outer ring plus four smaller ones on the inner diagonals. The outer ring sits at radius ~0.39, not 0.30.
Each rosette is a dense multi-ring medallion with a ~12-petal glowing centre, not a circle in outline with 8 spokes.
Magenta, cyan, orange and blue line-work with glowing filled centres.
A dense triangulated web of lines spans the whole frame between centre and rosettes, and vertical word-marks sit in the top-left and bottom-right corners.

30.subject: AMPHETAMEMES sits in the top-left: measured x ~4.1% to ~43%, cap line y ~7.6%, baseline y ~11.7%.
observed: AMPHETAMEMES sits in the top-left: measured x ~4.1% to ~43%, cap line y ~7.6%, baseline y ~11.7%.
The word spans ~0.39 of frame width, about half the required span.
A four-line legend block at bottom-left, a framed word-mark at bottom-right, ~10 small blue word labels around the outer ring, and small red numerals on the pink arcs, in addition to the 12 letters.
A framed publisher-style word-mark (".EVARJPIINE") sits in the bottom-right corner.
No gold border and no corner ornaments (only a thin grey frame line); the capitals are a geometric sans with a pink-to-cyan gradient, no stroke modulation and no bracketed serifs.
The frame centre holds a large magenta starburst geometry diagram; the word is off in the top-left corner.

31.subject: The only key is a five-row list at x ~25-27%, y ~83-91%, and its entries are small circular badges rather than 0.07 x 0.05 rectangular swatches.
observed: The only key is a five-row list at x ~25-27%, y ~83-91%, and its entries are small circular badges rather than 0.07 x 0.05 rectangular swatches.
No numerals appear in the key; each row is labelled with two lines of words.
The key rows read as words ("Metrit Grwert", "Pby alwopbod usaldte", "Auda rdorviloe", "Poe Tretiothl emveting", "Pby irgcom Peofthjtny").
Word labels on the key rows and on the corner dials ("moooi", "ttah" and similar).
The eight-pointed star is centred in the frame at ~(50.5%, 50.5%) with node radius ~0.33, not offset right to (66%, 50%) at 0.26.
The key entries are glossy shaded circular badges with gradient fills, not flat rectangles.

32.subject: Six identical large rosettes arranged hexagonally (top-centre, upper-right, lower-right, bottom-centre, lower-left, upper-left) plus a separate 16-ray central starburst — 6-fold, not 4-fold.
observed: Six identical large rosettes arranged hexagonally (top-centre, upper-right, lower-right, bottom-centre, lower-left, upper-left) plus a separate 16-ray central starburst — 6-fold, not 4-fold.
Hot magenta/pink, blue, orange and white line-work alongside the gold.
The lower-left motif is a fully 12-fold-symmetric rosette with a bright gold centre, identical in kind to the other five. Nothing quasi-representational appears anywhere in the frame.

33.subject: A two-page spread. The right page carries 3 panels in row 1, 2 in row 2 (left roughly double-width) and 2 in row 3 — 7 panels — while the entire left half is a black full-bleed double panel.
observed: A two-page spread. The right page carries 3 panels in row 1, 2 in row 2 (left roughly double-width) and 2 in row 3 — 7 panels — while the entire left half is a black full-bleed double panel.
The ground is black/dark throughout, and the panels are heavily saturated with pink, magenta, teal and white.
Magenta/pink fills large parts of several panels — both hands, multiple circuit fields, two faces and a screen — far above 0.055 of frame area.
The top-right panel carries a large arched word banner with a readable numeral "7" beneath it; letterform blocks also appear in the top-left panels.
The arched word banner with its numeral in the top-right panel reads as a page header/logo, and panel numbers ("73", "10", "1") appear in row 3.

34.subject: The ground is near-black (dark navy/black) with a white speckle starfield — the exact inverse of the requirement.
observed: The ground is near-black (dark navy/black) with a white speckle starfield — the exact inverse of the requirement.
Near-black dominates the frame.
The figure spans roughly 0.46 of frame width, sits cross-legged in a lotus pose, and is seen from the front.
The gap is filled by a large dotted halo of concentric rings, radiating spokes, a vertical spray of dots and star speckle.
The frame is among the densest in the set.

35.subject: No chevrons appear anywhere. The plate's subject is a seated cross-legged black silhouette at bottom centre with two large horned beast heads in the upper corners.
observed: No chevrons appear anywhere. The plate's subject is a seated cross-legged black silhouette at bottom centre with two large horned beast heads in the upper corners.
The central column is a dotted vertical trail from a bright rosette disc at the top down to a mid-height pentagram disc — it stops around y = 45% and is not 23 stacked marks.
No chevrons exist to point in any direction, so the canon-rule-1 test the plate exists to make is absent.
